files.name: Main.bas
files.text:
' STACKER - a falling block puzzle for the ZX Spectrum Next, in NTC BASIC.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' The seven four-block pieces fall into a well ten wide and twenty deep. Turn them and slide
' them so they fill whole rows: a full row goes. Two games: MARATHON (levels go up every ten
' rows, faster and faster) and SPRINT (forty rows, as quick as you can).
'
' Keys: O P left / right, A down a bit, Space drop, Q turn right, W turn left, H hold the piece
'       for later, M the music on / off. The joystick: left / right / down, up turns, fire drops.
'
' The well and the panels are the tilemap (Board.cls: a palette row a cell, so one block tile
' makes all seven colours); the picture behind is Layer 2.
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

Const BW = 10, BH = 22, WX = 15, WY = 4
' palette rows: 0 the frame / floor, 1-7 the pieces, 8 a flash, 9 grey, 10-13 words
Const C_WHITE = 10, C_YELLOW = 11, C_CYAN = 12, C_PINK = 13

Dim bd(219) As Byte, bag(6) As Integer, bagN As Integer, nq(2) As Integer
Dim cur As Integer, rot As Integer, cx As Integer, cy As Integer, gy As Integer
Dim hold As Integer, held As Integer, lockT As Integer, resets As Integer, fallT As Integer
Dim das As Integer, dasW As Integer, rotWas As Integer, dropWas As Integer, holdWas As Integer, musWas As Integer
Dim ox(3) As Integer, oy(3) As Integer, ogx(3) As Integer, ogy(3) As Integer, shown As Integer
Dim score As Long, lines As Integer, level As Integer, startLv As Integer, mode As Integer, over As Integer
Dim best(1) As Long, bestT As Long, timeF As Long, frames As Integer, music As Integer, musP As Integer, musT As Integer
Dim fullN As Integer, full(3) As Integer
Dim i As Integer, k As Integer

Nx.Border 0
Tiles.Init
Spr.Init
GfxData.Load
Sfx.Init
Board.Init
L2.Init
Nx.Layers Nx.OrderSUL
Colours
startLv = 1 : mode = 0 : music = 1 : bestT = 0
Do
  TitleScr
  Game
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- set up
Sub Colours()
  Board.Pal 0, "00FF7F1B0E0125DB92490000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 1, "00FF7F1B0E0125DB92490000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 2, "00FFFDD86C0125DB92490000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 3, "00FFCF83410125DB92490000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 4, "00FF7D34080125DB92490000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 5, "00FFEEC0600125DB92490000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 6, "00FF7327020125DB92490000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 7, "00FFF5EC840125DB92490000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 8, "00FFFFFFFF0125DB92490000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 9, "00FFB692490125DB92490000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 10, "00FF00000000000000000000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 11, "00FC00000000000000000000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 12, "001F00000000000000000000000026E3"
  Board.Pal 13, "00EE00000000000000000000000026E3"
End Sub

' the picture behind: deep blue with faint squares
Sub Backdrop()
  Dim y As Integer, x As Integer
  L2.Rect 0, 0, 256, 192, 1
  For k = 0 To 30
    x = (k * 53) Mod 244 : y = (k * 97) Mod 180
    L2.Rect x, y, 8, 8, &H25
    L2.Rect x + 1, y + 1, 6, 6, 1
  Next
End Sub

' piece p in turn r: its four cells (x, y in a 4 x 4 box) as eight digits
Function Shape(ByVal p As Integer, ByVal r As Integer) As String
  Select Case p
  Case 0: Shape = Mid$("01112131202122230212223210111213", r * 8 + 1, 8)
  Case 1: Shape = Mid$("10201121102011211020112110201121", r * 8 + 1, 8)
  Case 2: Shape = Mid$("10011121101121120111211210011112", r * 8 + 1, 8)
  Case 3: Shape = Mid$("10200111101121221121021200011112", r * 8 + 1, 8)
  Case 4: Shape = Mid$("00101121201121120111122210011102", r * 8 + 1, 8)
  Case 5: Shape = Mid$("00011121102011120111212210110212", r * 8 + 1, 8)
  Case 6: Shape = Mid$("20011121101112220111210200101112", r * 8 + 1, 8)
  End Select
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- keys, frames
Function Way() As Integer
  Dim j As Integer
  j = Keys.Joystick(0)
  Way = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or (j And Keys.JoyLeft) Then Way = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or (j And Keys.JoyRight) Then Way = 1
End Function

Function Fire() As Integer
  Fire = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or (Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyFire1) Then Fire = 1
End Function

Sub Tick()
  Frame
  Spr.Show
  Tune
  Sfx.Update
  frames = frames + 1
  If mode = 1 And over = 0 Then timeF = timeF + 1
End Sub

Sub WaitF(ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer
  For j = 1 To t
    Tick
  Next
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the music: an old Russian folk tune
' (notes: a letter and a length in eighths; a b c d e f g = A4 .. G5, h = A5, s / t = G#4 / G#5, r = rest)
Function Melody(ByVal part As Integer) As String
  If part < 2 Then
    Melody = "e2b1c1d2c1b1a2a1c1e2d1c1b3c1d2e2c2a2a4r1d2f1h2g1f1e3c1e2d1c1b2b1c1d2e2c2a2a2r2"
  Else
    Melody = "e4c4d4b4c4a4s4b2r2e4c4d4b4c2e2h4t8"
  End If
End Function

Sub Tune()
  Dim m As String Max 90, n As Integer, l As Integer, p As Integer
  If music = 0 Or over Then Exit Sub
  musT = musT - 1
  If musT > 0 Then Exit Sub
  m = Melody(musP \ 100)
  n = Asc(Mid$(m, musP Mod 100 + 1, 1))
  l = Val(Mid$(m, musP Mod 100 + 2, 1)) * 9
  Select Case Chr$(n)
  Case "a": p = 249
  Case "b": p = 221
  Case "c": p = 209
  Case "d": p = 186
  Case "e": p = 166
  Case "f": p = 157
  Case "g": p = 140
  Case "h": p = 124
  Case "s": p = 263
  Case "t": p = 132
  Case Else: p = 0
  End Select
  If p Then Sfx.Play 0, p, 0, 10, l - 1, 0
  musT = l
  musP = musP + 2
  If musP Mod 100 >= Len(m) Then
    musP = (musP \ 100 + 1) * 100
    If musP >= 300 Then musP = 0
  End If
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Sub TitleScr()
  Dim v As Integer, was As Integer, a As Integer
  over = 1
  Spr.HideRange 0, 64
  Board.Clear
  Backdrop
  L2.Big 16, 12, "STACK", 6, &HFC, &HEC
  L2.Big 112, 66, "ER", 4, &H1F, &H0B
  Board.Text 6, 20, "FILL WHOLE ROWS TO CLEAR THEM.", C_WHITE
  Board.Text 3, 26, "O P MOVE  A DOWN  SPACE DROP", C_CYAN
  Board.Text 3, 27, "Q W TURN  H HOLD  M MUSIC ON/OFF", C_CYAN
  Board.Text 8, 31, "(C) 2026 CYBORG UNICORN", C_WHITE
  was = 1
  Do
    If mode = 0 Then
      Board.Text 8, 22, "<  MARATHON  >          ", C_YELLOW
      Board.Text 8, 23, "START AT LEVEL" & Str$(startLv) & " (Q A) ", C_WHITE
      Board.Text 8, 24, "BEST " & Right$("000000" & Mid$(Str$(best(0)), 2), 7) & "     ", C_PINK
    Else
      Board.Text 8, 22, "<   SPRINT   >          ", C_YELLOW
      Board.Text 8, 23, "40 ROWS AGAINST THE CLOCK", C_WHITE
      If bestT Then Board.Text 8, 24, "BEST " & Clock(bestT) & "        ", C_PINK Else Board.Text 8, 24, "                  ", C_PINK
    End If
    Board.Text 12, 29, "SPACE: START", C_YELLOW
    Do
      Tick
      a = frames
      ' a few blocks bobbing about
      For k = 0 To 6
        Spr.Put k, 24 + k * 40, 138 + Val(Mid$(" 0 1 2 3 2 1 0-1-2-3-2-1", ((a \ 5 + k * 2) Mod 12) * 2 + 1, 2)), GfxData.S_BIG, Spr.Pal * (k + 1)
      Next
      k = Rnd(10)
      v = 0
      If Way() < 0 Then v = 1
      If Way() > 0 Then v = 2
      If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Then v = 3
      If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Then v = 4
      If Fire() Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyEnter) Then v = 9
      If v = 0 Then was = 0
    Loop Until v <> 0 And was = 0
    was = 1
    If v = 1 Or v = 2 Then mode = 1 - mode
    If v = 3 And startLv < 15 Then startLv = startLv + 1
    If v = 4 And startLv > 1 Then startLv = startLv - 1
  Loop Until v = 9
  Spr.HideRange 0, 64
End Sub

Function Clock(ByVal f As Long) As String
  Dim s As Long, cs As Long
  s = f \ 50 : cs = (f Mod 50) * 2
  Clock = Mid$(Str$(s \ 60), 2) & ":" & Right$("0" & Mid$(Str$(s Mod 60), 2), 2) & "." & Right$("0" & Mid$(Str$(cs), 2), 2)
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- a game
Sub Game()
  Board.Clear
  Backdrop
  For i = 0 To 219
    bd(i) = 0
  Next
  score = 0 : lines = 0 : level = startLv : timeF = 0 : over = 0
  If mode = 1 Then level = 1
  hold = -1 : bagN = 7 : musP = 0 : musT = 1
  Well
  For k = 0 To 2
    nq(k) = NextPiece()
  Next
  Panels
  NewPiece
  Do
    Tick
    If mode = 1 Then
      If frames Mod 5 = 0 Then Board.Text 3, 21, Clock(timeF) & " ", C_YELLOW
    End If
    Controls
    If over Then Exit Do
    If mode = 1 And lines >= 40 Then Exit Do
  Loop
  Sfx.Quiet
  If over Then
    ' the well fills with grey from the bottom
    For k = BH - 1 To 2 Step -1
      For i = 0 To BW - 1
        Board.Put WX + i, WY + k, GfxData.T_BLOCK, 9
      Next
      Sfx.Play 1, 100 + k * 20, 0, 10, 3, 1
      WaitF 3
    Next
    Board.Text WX + 1, WY + 10, "GAME OVER", C_PINK
    If mode = 0 And score > best(0) Then best(0) = score : Board.Text WX, WY + 12, "BEST SCORE", C_YELLOW
  Else
    over = 1
    Board.Text 3, 21, Clock(timeF) & " ", C_YELLOW
    Board.Text WX + 1, WY + 10, "40 ROWS!", C_YELLOW
    Board.Text WX + 1, WY + 12, Clock(timeF), C_WHITE
    If bestT = 0 Or timeF < bestT Then bestT = timeF : Board.Text WX + 1, WY + 14, "BEST TIME", C_PINK
    For k = 0 To 4
      Sfx.Play 0, 200 - k * 30, 0, 13, 10, 0
      WaitF 10
    Next
  End If
  WaitF 100
  Do
    Tick
  Loop Until Fire() Or Keys.Down(Keys.KeyEnter)
  Do
    Tick
  Loop While Fire()
End Sub

' the well's frame and floor
Sub Well()
  Board.Put WX - 1, WY + 1, GfxData.T_FRAME, 0
  Board.Put WX + BW, WY + 1, GfxData.T_FRAME + 2, 0
  For i = 0 To BW - 1
    Board.Put WX + i, WY + 1, GfxData.T_FRAME + 1, 0
    Board.Put WX + i, WY + BH, GfxData.T_FRAME + 6, 0
  Next
  For k = 2 To BH - 1
    Board.Put WX - 1, WY + k, GfxData.T_FRAME + 3, 0
    Board.Put WX + BW, WY + k, GfxData.T_FRAME + 4, 0
    For i = 0 To BW - 1
      Board.Put WX + i, WY + k, GfxData.T_FLOOR, 0
    Next
  Next
  Board.Put WX - 1, WY + BH, GfxData.T_FRAME + 5, 0
  Board.Put WX + BW, WY + BH, GfxData.T_FRAME + 7, 0
End Sub

' a box at x, y (inside w x h) with a title
Sub Box(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As String)
  Dim a As Integer, b As Integer
  Board.Put x - 1, y - 1, GfxData.T_FRAME, 0 : Board.Put x + w, y - 1, GfxData.T_FRAME + 2, 0
  Board.Put x - 1, y + h, GfxData.T_FRAME + 5, 0 : Board.Put x + w, y + h, GfxData.T_FRAME + 7, 0
  For a = 0 To w - 1
    Board.Put x + a, y - 1, GfxData.T_FRAME + 1, 0 : Board.Put x + a, y + h, GfxData.T_FRAME + 6, 0
  Next
  For b = 0 To h - 1
    Board.Put x - 1, y + b, GfxData.T_FRAME + 3, 0 : Board.Put x + w, y + b, GfxData.T_FRAME + 4, 0
    For a = 0 To w - 1
      Board.Put x + a, y + b, GfxData.T_PANEL, 0
    Next
  Next
  Board.Text x, y - 2, t, C_WHITE
End Sub

Sub Panels()
  Box 3, 8, 6, 4, "HOLD"
  Box 28, 8, 6, 12, "NEXT"
  Box 3, 16, 9, 6, ""
  If mode = 0 Then Board.Text 1, 4, "MARATHON", C_YELLOW Else Board.Text 1, 4, "SPRINT 40", C_YELLOW
  Stats
  ShowNext
  ShowHold
End Sub

Sub Stats()
  Board.Text 3, 16, "SCORE", C_WHITE
  Board.Text 3, 17, Right$("0000000" & Mid$(Str$(score), 2), 7), C_YELLOW
  Board.Text 3, 18, "ROWS" & Right$("    " & Str$(lines), 5), C_CYAN
  Board.Text 3, 19, "LEVEL" & Right$("   " & Str$(level), 4), C_CYAN
  If mode = 1 Then Board.Text 3, 20, "TIME", C_WHITE
End Sub

' piece p drawn small at x, y (tiles), or cleared
Sub Mini(ByVal p As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Dim s As String Max 8, j As Integer, up As Integer
  For j = 0 To 11
    Board.Put x + j Mod 4, y + j \ 4, GfxData.T_PANEL, 0
  Next
  If p < 0 Then Exit Sub
  s = Shape(p, 0)
  up = 0
  If p = 0 Then up = 1
  For j = 0 To 3
    Board.Put x + Val(Mid$(s, j * 2 + 1, 1)), y + Val(Mid$(s, j * 2 + 2, 1)) - up, GfxData.T_BLOCK, p + 1
  Next
End Sub

Sub ShowNext()
  For k = 0 To 2
    Mini nq(k), 29, 9 + k * 4
  Next
End Sub

Sub ShowHold()
  Mini hold, 4, 9
End Sub

' the next piece from the bag (each bag holds all seven, in a shuffled order)
Function NextPiece() As Integer
  Dim j As Integer, t As Integer, r As Integer
  If bagN >= 7 Then
    For j = 0 To 6
      bag(j) = j
    Next
    For j = 6 To 1 Step -1
      r = Rnd(j + 1)
      t = bag(j) : bag(j) = bag(r) : bag(r) = t
    Next
    bagN = 0
  End If
  NextPiece = bag(bagN)
  bagN = bagN + 1
End Function

Sub NewPiece()
  cur = nq(0) : nq(0) = nq(1) : nq(1) = nq(2) : nq(2) = NextPiece()
  ShowNext
  Spawn
  held = 0
End Sub

Sub Spawn()
  rot = 0 : cx = 3 : cy = 0
  If cur = 0 Then cy = 0
  lockT = 0 : resets = 0 : fallT = 0 : shown = 0
  If Fits(cx, cy, rot) = 0 Then over = 1 : Exit Sub
  ' (drop into view straight away)
  If Fits(cx, cy + 1, rot) Then cy = cy + 1
  Show
End Sub

' does the current piece fit at x, y in turn r
Function Fits(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
  Dim s As String Max 8, j As Integer, a As Integer, b As Integer
  s = Shape(cur, r)
  Fits = 1
  For j = 0 To 3
    a = x + Asc(Mid$(s, j * 2 + 1, 1)) - 48 : b = y + Asc(Mid$(s, j * 2 + 2, 1)) - 48
    If a < 0 Or a >= BW Or b >= BH Then Fits = 0 : Exit Function
    If b >= 0 Then
      If bd(b * BW + a) Then Fits = 0 : Exit Function
    End If
  Next
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing the piece and its ghost
Sub Show()
  Dim s As String Max 8, j As Integer, a As Integer, b As Integer
  ' off with the old
  If shown Then
    For j = 0 To 3
      Cell ogx(j), ogy(j)
      Cell ox(j), oy(j)
    Next
  End If
  gy = cy
  Do While Fits(cx, gy + 1, rot)
    gy = gy + 1
  Loop
  s = Shape(cur, rot)
  For j = 0 To 3
    a = cx + Asc(Mid$(s, j * 2 + 1, 1)) - 48 : b = Asc(Mid$(s, j * 2 + 2, 1)) - 48
    ogx(j) = a : ogy(j) = gy + b
    ox(j) = a : oy(j) = cy + b
  Next
  For j = 0 To 3
    If ogy(j) >= 2 Then Board.Put WX + ogx(j), WY + ogy(j), GfxData.T_GHOST, cur + 1
  Next
  For j = 0 To 3
    If oy(j) >= 2 Then Board.Put WX + ox(j), WY + oy(j), GfxData.T_BLOCK, cur + 1
  Next
  shown = 1
End Sub

' redraw a cell of the well from what's in it
Sub Cell(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Dim c As Integer
  If y < 2 Then Exit Sub
  c = bd(y * BW + x)
  If c Then Board.Put WX + x, WY + y, GfxData.T_BLOCK, c Else Board.Put WX + x, WY + y, GfxData.T_FLOOR, 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- playing
Function Gravity() As Integer
  Dim l As Integer
  l = level
  If l > 20 Then l = 20
  Gravity = Val(Mid$("4036322823191511070504040403030302020201", (l - 1) * 2 + 1, 2))
End Function

Sub Controls()
  Dim w As Integer, j As Integer, t As Integer, moved As Integer, drop As Integer
  moved = 0
  ' left / right: once, then repeating after a moment
  w = Way()
  If w <> 0 Then
    If w <> dasW Then
      dasW = w : das = 0
      If Fits(cx + w, cy, rot) Then cx = cx + w : moved = 1 : Sfx.Play 1, 400, 0, 6, 2, 0
    Else
      das = das + 1
      If das >= 10 And das Mod 2 = 0 Then
        If Fits(cx + w, cy, rot) Then cx = cx + w : moved = 1
      End If
    End If
  Else
    dasW = 0
  End If
  ' turning (with a nudge sideways or up if it won't fit)
  t = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or (Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyUp) Then t = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyW) Then t = 3
  If t And rotWas = 0 Then
    If Turn((rot + t) And 3) Then moved = 1 : Sfx.Play 1, 300, -10, 7, 3, 0
  End If
  rotWas = t
  ' hold
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyH) Then
    If holdWas = 0 And held = 0 Then
      HideCur
      If hold < 0 Then
        hold = cur : ShowHold : NewPiece
      Else
        j = hold : hold = cur : cur = j : ShowHold : Spawn
      End If
      held = 1
      Sfx.Play 2, 150, 10, 9, 6, 0
      holdWas = 1
      Exit Sub
    End If
    holdWas = 1
  Else
    holdWas = 0
  End If
  ' the music
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) Then
    If musWas = 0 Then music = 1 - music : Sfx.Quiet
    musWas = 1
  Else
    musWas = 0
  End If
  ' a hard drop
  If Fire() Then
    If dropWas = 0 Then
      dropWas = 1
      Points CLng(gy - cy) * 2
      cy = gy
      Show
      Sfx.Play 2, 60, 4, 13, 6, 1
      Lock
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Else
    dropWas = 0
  End If
  ' falling: faster while A (or down) is held
  drop = Gravity()
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or (Keys.Joystick(0) And Keys.JoyDown) Then
    If drop > 2 Then drop = 2
  End If
  fallT = fallT + 1
  If fallT >= drop Then
    fallT = 0
    If Fits(cx, cy + 1, rot) Then
      cy = cy + 1 : moved = 1 : lockT = 0
      If drop = 2 And Gravity() > 2 Then Points 1
    End If
  End If
  ' resting on something: it locks after a moment (moving it puts that off, up to 15 times)
  If Fits(cx, cy + 1, rot) = 0 Then
    lockT = lockT + 1
    If moved And resets < 15 Then lockT = 0 : resets = resets + 1
    If lockT >= 30 Then Lock : Exit Sub
  End If
  If moved Then Show
End Sub

Function Turn(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
  Dim j As Integer, kx As Integer, ky As Integer
  Turn = 0
  For j = 0 To 7
    kx = Val(Mid$(" 0-1 1 0-1 1-2 2", j * 2 + 1, 2)) : ky = Val(Mid$(" 0 0 0-1-1-1 0 0", j * 2 + 1, 2))
    If j >= 6 And cur <> 0 Then Exit Function
    If Fits(cx + kx, cy + ky, r) Then
      cx = cx + kx : cy = cy + ky : rot = r : Turn = 1
      Exit Function
    End If
  Next
End Function

Sub HideCur()
  Dim j As Integer
  If shown Then
    For j = 0 To 3
      Cell ogx(j), ogy(j)
      Cell ox(j), oy(j)
    Next
  End If
  shown = 0
End Sub

' the piece stays where it is: full rows go, the next piece comes
Sub Lock()
  Dim j As Integer, y As Integer, x As Integer, n As Integer, f As Integer, w As Integer
  For j = 0 To 3
    If oy(j) >= 0 Then bd(oy(j) * BW + ox(j)) = cur + 1
  Next
  For j = 0 To 3
    Cell ogx(j), ogy(j)
    Cell ox(j), oy(j)
  Next
  shown = 0
  Sfx.Play 2, 80, 2, 9, 4, 1
  ' full rows?
  n = 0
  For y = 0 To BH - 1
    f = 1
    For x = 0 To BW - 1
      If bd(y * BW + x) = 0 Then f = 0 : Exit For
    Next
    If f Then full(n) = y : n = n + 1
  Next
  If n > 0 Then
    ' they flash, then go
    For w = 0 To 15
      For j = 0 To n - 1
        For x = 0 To BW - 1
          If w Mod 4 < 2 Then Board.Put WX + x, WY + full(j), GfxData.T_BLOCK, 8 Else Cell x, full(j)
        Next
      Next
      If w = 0 Then
        If n = 4 Then Sfx.Play 0, 100, -3, 15, 30, 0 Else Sfx.Play 1, 200, -8, 13, 15, 0
      End If
      Tick
    Next
    For j = 0 To n - 1
      For y = full(j) To 1 Step -1
        For x = 0 To BW - 1
          bd(y * BW + x) = bd((y - 1) * BW + x)
        Next
      Next
      For x = 0 To BW - 1
        bd(x) = 0
      Next
    Next
    For y = 2 To BH - 1
      For x = 0 To BW - 1
        Cell x, y
      Next
    Next
    lines = lines + n
    Points CLng(Val(Mid$("010030050080", (n - 1) * 3 + 1, 3))) * 10 * level
    If mode = 0 And lines \ 10 + startLv > level Then
      level = lines \ 10 + startLv
      Sfx.Play 2, 50, -2, 14, 30, 0
    End If
    Stats
  End If
  WaitF 4
  NewPiece
End Sub

Sub Points(ByVal n As Long)
  score = score + n
  Board.Text 3, 17, Right$("0000000" & Mid$(Str$(score), 2), 7), C_YELLOW
End Sub

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Board.cls
files.text:
' Board - the card table on the Next's tilemap: 40 x 32 cells, 2 bytes each (the tile, its palette
' row), so each card can be in its own colours. The tiles (GfxData) at bank 5 + #0000, the map at
' bank 5 + #2000 (#E000).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
Option Explicit

Private tc As Integer

' Init: the tilemap with attributes (after Tiles.Init and GfxData.Load)
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &H81                        ' the tilemap: on, 40 x 32, 2 bytes a cell, 4 bit
  Clear
End Sub

' Clear: every cell tile 0 (see-through)
Public Sub Clear()
#asm
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 2559
            ld (hl), 0
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Put x, y, t, p: cell x, y shows tile t in palette row p
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer, ByVal p As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a                 ; DE = #E000 + (y * 40 + x) * 2
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, 0
            add hl, bc
            add hl, hl
            ld de, #E000
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Text x, y, s, p: a string from cell x, y in palette row p (the font is the tiles 32-95)
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal p As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, 0
            add hl, bc
            add hl, hl
            ld de, #E000
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld ({tc}), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld c, a
            ld hl, ({tc})
st_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, st_done
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, c
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld a, d
            cp #EA
            jr nc, st_done
            jr st_lp
st_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t, p: a block of one tile
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer, ByVal p As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t, p
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Pal row, s: the tilemap's palette row (0-15) from s, 16 colours as hex pairs (RRRGGGBB)
Public Sub Pal(ByVal row As Integer, ByVal s As String)
  Dim k As Integer
  For k = 0 To 15
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalTiles, row * 16 + k, Hx(s, k)
  Next
End Sub

' Hx(s, k): the k-th hex pair in s
Private Function Hx(ByVal s As String, ByVal k As Integer) As Integer
  Dim a As Integer, b As Integer
  a = Asc(Mid$(s, k * 2 + 1, 1)) : b = Asc(Mid$(s, k * 2 + 2, 1))
  If a > 57 Then a = a - 55 Else a = a - 48
  If b > 57 Then b = b - 55 Else b = b - 48
  Hx = a * 16 + b
End Function

files.name: L2.cls
files.text:
' L2 - Layer 2 for the backdrops: 256 x 192, one byte a pixel (RRRGGGBB colours), bank 16 (pages
' 32-37, each 32 lines, put in at #C000 through MMU slot 6 while drawing, then bank 5's page 10
' back). Behind the tilemap and the sprites.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
Option Explicit

Private sc As Integer, sw As Integer, fa As Integer, pb As Integer, vis As Integer

' Init: Layer 2 on, 256 x 192, no scroll, the whole of it
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0
  Nx.Reg &H12, 16
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 1
  Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 255 : Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0 : Nx.Reg &H17, 0
  Out &H123B, 2
  ' two screens: bank 16 and bank 19. Both cleared; bank 16 is shown and drawn on
  vis = 19 : pb = 38
  Rect 0, 0, 256, 192, 0
  vis = 16 : pb = 32
  Rect 0, 0, 256, 192, 0
End Sub

' Back: draw on the screen that isn't shown (until Flip)
Public Sub Back()
  If vis = 16 Then pb = 38 Else pb = 32
End Sub

' Flip: show the screen just drawn on (and keep drawing on it)
Public Sub Flip()
  vis = pb \ 2
  Nx.Reg &H12, vis
End Sub

' Span x, y, w, c: w pixels (1-256, not past the right edge) of colour c from x, y
Public Sub Span(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; y
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; w
            ld ({sw}), bc
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({sc}), a            ; colour
            ld a, d
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            ld h, a
            ld a, ({pb})
            add a, h
            ld h, a                 ; the page: pb + y / 32
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, h
            out (c), a
            ld a, d
            and 31
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld l, e                 ; HL = #C000 + (y And 31) * 256 + x
            ld bc, ({sw})
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr z, l2_back
            ld a, ({sc})
            ld (hl), a
            dec bc
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr z, l2_back
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            inc de
            ldir
l2_back:
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, c: a block
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    Span x, j, w, c
  Next
End Sub

' Plot x, y, c: one pixel
Public Sub Plot(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  If x >= 0 And x < 256 And y >= 0 And y < 192 Then Span x, y, 1, c
End Sub

' Big x, y, s, z, c1, c2: text s drawn z times the size, colour c1 on top shading to c2, with a
' dark shadow (colour 0) two pixels down and right. The letters are read from the tilemap's font
' (tiles 32-95 at #C000, 4 bits a pixel: colour 1 is the letter)
Public Sub Big(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal c1 As Integer, ByVal c2 As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer, r As Integer, b As Integer, i As Integer, run As Integer, a As Integer, col As Integer, pass As Integer, sh As Integer, m As Integer, v As Integer
  For pass = 0 To 1
    sh = (1 - pass) * 2
    For k = 1 To Len(s)
      a = &HC000 + Asc(Mid$(s, k, 1)) * 32
      For r = 0 To 7
        b = 0 : m = 128
        For i = 0 To 3
          v = Peek(a + r * 4 + i)
          If (v \ 16) = 1 Then b = b Or m
          If (v And 15) = 1 Then b = b Or (m \ 2)
          m = m \ 4
        Next
        col = 0
        If pass Then
          col = c2
          If r < 4 Then col = c1
        End If
        i = 0
        Do While b
          If b And 128 Then
            run = 0
            Do While b And 128
              run = run + 1 : b = (b * 2) And 255
            Loop
            Rect x + ((k - 1) * 8 + i) * z + sh, y + r * z + sh, run * z, z, col
            i = i + run
          Else
            i = i + 1 : b = (b * 2) And 255
          End If
        Loop
      Next
    Next
  Next
End Sub
